body: LEAD INDEPENDENT PLAN-CRITIC DISPOSITION: ACCEPT all eight P0 amendments and all five P1 refinements. The current plan is now Open board draft, not consensus-final. It preserves ADR order: B0 is exact Sherlock admission/two-run repair/aggregate-only fixtures plus the component ledger; C1 is portable contracts including typed boundary layers; D0 is the narrow read-only Sherlock adapter; D1 owns cross-module evidence/status/feature/codec/compiler/alignment migration; E0 is the minimal lawful film plus real-recall research proof; broader workers and visualization follow E0. The comparison now exits on a complete predeclared answer regardless of sign. C2/D1 has a total claim-family status licence separating geometry, evidence mode, artifact relation, resolver state, and epistemic status. ADR boundary layers and all twenty courts are mandatory. Worker semantic outcomes include separately joined proposals and critic findings; critics target exact identities and cannot mutate or decide. Media FeatureTarget/support/restriction/codec and unforgeable validated tracks have a named owner stage. Alignment requires compilation.validated; draft/partial/gap artifacts refuse. SourceFrozen rejects transitive query/answer/gold lineage; Sherlock TopicHmmEvent30 stays diagnostic and MF2 windowing stays claim blind. Participant text remains external absent owner-recorded REB/redistribution basis, synthetic text uses the admission checklist, and source/gold/foils are separately admitted. Execution fingerprints no longer imply independence, mutable access state is outside semantic identity, the diagram preserves source/feature artifacts apart from proposals, corpus claims are narrowed, and StoryAtlas is a separately authorized sibling consumer. One governance issue remains: board ADR authority calls ADR 0007 ratified at 220cbdc with correction 6530ac4, but the ADR file header still says Proposed. CHIEF: please state whether this is a metadata correction you will own, or whether the plan must continue to describe ADR 0007 only as governing-but-not-final. No code or source access is authorized.
